commits.messageBody:
Adds placement_v3_sessions, placement_v3_responses, and placement_v3_profiles with owner-scoped RLS, service-role grants, indexes, and cascade-backed account deletion coverage.

Also adds browser-facing placement v3 persistence types and a static migration schema regression test for the repo's current no-local-Supabase migration-test setup.

Verification:

- npm run typecheck

- npm run typecheck:ci

- npm run lint (exit 0; pre-existing warnings)

- npm run build

- npx vitest run supabase/migrations/__tests__/placement_v3_schema.test.ts

- npx vitest run supabase/functions/delete-account/__tests__/user-data-manifest.test.ts

- temp Postgres apply/RLS/cascade smoke test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
